key_insight: PhiBE-PI learns continuous-time policies from a fixed batch of discrete-time off-policy transitions using one state-action critic while preserving the action-ranking signal.
engineering_relevance: The framework enables policy improvement for unknown stochastic dynamics without explicitly estimating drift or diffusion or collecting fresh data at each iteration.
method: Learn a single state-action critic directly from sampled increments.
Improve the policy iteratively while reusing the same off-policy batch.
Use linear function approximation with a local end-to-end suboptimality guarantee.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical bounds tracking discretization, approximation, and finite-sample errors through data-reusing policy iteration, but provides no empirical results.
watch_item: Smaller sampling intervals reduce discretization error but can increase statistical error at fixed sample size, so finer sampling need not improve policy performance.
paper_title: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
